USA.summary: Global power-projection military with joint force structure, major alliance commitments, large defense budget, advanced C4I, and substantial strategic transport and sustainment capacity.
USA.sourceNotes: Use CIA World Factbook for public country/military descriptors, SIPRI for expenditure time series, NATO for alliance status, and U.S. DoD public releases for force posture summaries.

force_structure_summary.label: joint_global_force
force_structure_summary.notes: Service list only; no unit locations.

logistics_depth.notes: Global sustainment and transport capacity at country level.

alliance_commitments.other: Multiple bilateral and multilateral security commitments.

CHN.summary: Large, modernizing military with strong regional anti-access capabilities, growing blue-water naval reach, centralized party-state command, and major domestic defense-industrial capacity.
CHN.sourceNotes: Use CIA World Factbook and public defense white papers/official releases; record any country-specific official URL when extending.

nuclear_policy_public.notes: Public policy summary only; do not encode targeting assumptions.

RUS.summary: Large nuclear-armed military with extensive ground, aerospace, naval, missile, and internal security components; current readiness and losses are conflict-sensitive and require date-bound sourcing.
RUS.sourceNotes: Refresh with dated public sources before use; avoid live operational disposition or tactical loss claims.

force_structure_summary.label: large_multi_service_force
force_structure_summary.notes: Conflict-era values must be separately dated.

training_experience.notes: Public reporting varies by formation and date; keep sparse.

industrial_reconstitution_capacity.notes: Sanctions and wartime production assumptions require source-specific overlays.

IND.summary: Large military with major land-force commitments, growing maritime and aerospace capabilities, nuclear deterrent, and expanding domestic defense industry.
IND.sourceNotes: Use official Indian defense ministry releases and budget documents for extension.

GBR.summary: NATO nuclear-armed military with expeditionary professional forces, advanced maritime/air capabilities, and strong alliance integration.
GBR.sourceNotes: Use UK Ministry of Defence public documents for detailed public force-structure updates.

FRA.summary: NATO/EU nuclear-armed military with expeditionary capabilities, overseas commitments, advanced aerospace/naval industry, and independent strategic deterrent.
FRA.sourceNotes: Use French defense ministry and public military programming documents for extension.

IRN.summary: Regional military with regular and parallel revolutionary-guard structures, missile/drone emphasis, layered internal security roles, sanctions-shaped logistics, and high uncertainty in many capability estimates.
IRN.sourceNotes: Use public institute assessments and official statements carefully; keep proxy or live regional activity out of baseline records unless high-level and dated.

logistics_depth.notes: Sanctions and domestic substitution assumptions require source-specific evidence.

nuclear_policy_public.notes: Model nuclear-policy variables only from public legal/diplomatic sources.

ISR.summary: Highly trained regional military with reserve-heavy mobilization model, advanced air/C4I/intelligence capabilities, active border and internal security pressures, and dense political-legal constraints.
ISR.sourceNotes: Conflict-era values must be dated; exclude live force locations and tactical readiness details.

UKR.summary: Wartime military with large mobilized force structure, extensive partner support, rapidly adapted doctrine and uncrewed systems use, and high uncertainty in personnel, inventory, readiness, and attrition variables.
UKR.sourceNotes: Treat all conflict-related values as date-bound; do not include live positions, targeting, tactical force availability, or sensitive aid flow details.

TWN.summary: Self-governing entity with public defense data, reserve and civil-defense emphasis, island geography, high-end air/naval/missile threats in scenario context, and strong dependence on political assumptions.
TWN.sourceNotes: Use Taiwan Ministry of National Defense public reports for extension; keep sovereignty/status distinct from military variables.

alliance_commitments.other: Security relationships and support assumptions must be scenario overlays, not baseline facts.

variables.name: Equipment inventory coverage
variables.safety_notes: Pointer to equipment_inventory completeness by category; do not duplicate platform rows here.

processes.name: Order propagation
processes.purpose: Convert player/policy actions into delayed, friction-affected force tasks.
processes.safety_boundary: Use abstract delays only; do not model exploitable command-network paths.

processes.name: Logistics consumption
processes.purpose: Estimate supply drawdown from op tempo and force composition.
processes.safety_boundary: Avoid exact depot inventories, routes, or live stockpile locations.

processes.name: Readiness decay
processes.purpose: Apply fatigue, maintenance, casualty, and supply penalties over time.
processes.safety_boundary: Use coarse model parameters and source notes.

processes.name: Force reconstitution
processes.purpose: Estimate replacement and repair time under public industrial and budget constraints.
processes.safety_boundary: No supplier vulnerability mapping or procurement exploit details.

processes.name: Engagement resolution
processes.purpose: Use abstract combat power, terrain, training, and superiority modifiers to estimate losses and displacement.
processes.safety_boundary: Do not include targeting data, live positions, or weapon employment instructions.

capabilities.name: Armored direct fire and shock action
capabilities.description: Tracked armored force capability for protected direct fire, breakthrough support, counterattack, and terrain seizure.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Do not include live unit locations, route recommendations, weak-point analysis, or tactical employment instructions.

capabilities.name: Multirole air combat
capabilities.description: Fighter capability for air-to-air, air-to-surface, interdiction, and defensive counter-air simulation effects.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Use aggregate fleet-level effects only; exclude basing, mission planning, route, loadout, and vulnerability details.

capabilities.name: Stealth penetrating air combat
capabilities.description: Low-observable combat aircraft capability represented as abstract access, sensing, and strike modifiers.
capabilities.safety_boundary: No signatures, tactics, mission profiles, electronic order of battle, or countermeasure details.

capabilities.name: Area air and missile defense
capabilities.description: Surface-based air defense capability modeled as abstract defended-area and denial effects.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Do not include exact site locations, engagement geometry, radar modes, coverage maps, or vulnerability analysis.

capabilities.name: Counter-rocket, artillery, mortar defense
capabilities.description: Short-range air defense and interception capability against rockets, artillery shells, mortars, and small aerial threats where publicly described.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Keep at public system-class level; exclude battery locations, coverage gaps, firing doctrine, and interceptor depletion estimates.

capabilities.name: One-way attack UAV / loitering munition effects
capabilities.description: Publicly reported uncrewed one-way attack or loitering munition capability represented as an abstract strike pressure input.
capabilities.safety_boundary: No construction details, guidance methods, mission planning, routes, target selection, or evasion advice.

capabilities.name: Surface combatant area defense
capabilities.description: Major surface combatant capability for fleet air defense, escort, strike, and maritime presence at aggregate class level.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Do not include live ship locations, patrol patterns, magazine state, or tactical employment guidance.

capabilities.name: Integrated air defense command and control
capabilities.description: Battle-management software and command systems that fuse sensors, allocate interceptors, and coordinate public air-defense capabilities at an abstract level.
capabilities.safety_boundary: No network architecture, interfaces, credentials, frequencies, vulnerabilities, or jamming/evasion details.

capabilities.name: Joint tactical data link
capabilities.description: Publicly acknowledged tactical data-link capability represented as interoperability and situational-awareness modifiers.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Exclude technical parameters, crypto, waveforms, frequencies, network topology, or exploitation guidance.

capabilities.name: Multi-domain command and control
capabilities.description: Public program-level capability for coordinating land, air, maritime, space, cyber, and information effects.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Program-level abstractions only; no architectures, interfaces, vulnerabilities, or operational workflows.

capabilities.name: Logistics enterprise visibility
capabilities.description: Software-enabled capability for public, aggregate modeling of supply visibility, maintenance tracking, and sustainment planning.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Exclude system access, routes, depot inventories, maintenance bottlenecks, or exploitable supply-chain details.

capabilities.name: Public nuclear deterrence capability
capabilities.description: Publicly declared nuclear-capable force or policy represented as strategic deterrence and escalation-risk variables.
capabilities.safety_boundary: Use public policy and delivery-system classes only; exclude targeting, alert status, patrol status, command details, and weapon design.

actionTypes.name: Relocate force
actionTypes.description: Move a force element between abstract regions or operational areas subject to mobility, C2, logistics, terrain, and political constraints.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: No real route planning, live unit tracking, or operational movement advice.

actionTypes.name: Commit armored attack
actionTypes.description: Inject an abstract land offensive action using armored direct-fire and mobility capabilities.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: Simulation abstraction only; no tactical instructions or target guidance.

actionTypes.name: Generate air sorties
actionTypes.description: Create abstract air activity from multirole or stealth air-combat capabilities.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: No basing, routing, target selection, loadout, or mission planning.

actionTypes.name: Activate area air defense posture
actionTypes.description: Apply abstract defensive air and missile defense effects to a region or force grouping.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: No site locations, coverage maps, radar settings, engagement geometry, or vulnerability analysis.

actionTypes.name: Resupply force
actionTypes.description: Apply sustainment inputs to recover supply state and readiness for a force element.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: No depot inventories, route planning, convoy details, or supply-chain vulnerability mapping.

actionTypes.name: Change rules of engagement
actionTypes.description: Alter scenario-level political/legal permissions and constraints on military actions.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: Model legal and political constraints; do not use to bypass LOAC or targeting safeguards.

actionTypes.name: Mobilize reserves
actionTypes.description: Move entity manpower and units from peacetime to heightened, partial, or general mobilization states.
actionTypes.safety_boundary: Use public mobilization laws and aggregate manpower; no unit recall lists or individual data.
